label: SYNTHETIC_UPPER_BOUND
kind: DESCRIPTIVE PROPERTIES OF THE LABELS. No alternative target was scored for recoverability. No new construct was tested.
why_this_exists: Before reporting 'the frontend cannot recover register', the construct-validity doctrine requires asking whether the TARGET was an adequate proxy for register. It was not obviously so, and these are the label statistics that decide it.

hypothesis_FALSIFIED.claim: the global weighted mean is mostly an arrangement-bookkeeping artefact - it moves when instruments enter and leave, not when the music changes register
hypothesis_FALSIFIED.test: R^2 of predicting the target from polyphony count alone
hypothesis_FALSIFIED.verdict: FALSIFIED. Polyphony count explains essentially none of the target. The target is not a note-count artefact.

hypothesis_SUPPORTED.claim: a single global register scalar is a poor proxy for 'register state', because the texture's top and bottom move independently
evidence: corr(highest voice, lowest voice) = 0.066 - the melodic top and the bass are very nearly UNCORRELATED across 145,928 frames
the global weighted mean correlates only 0.598 with the top voice and 0.465 with the bottom, so it tracks NEITHER well
the top voice has sd 8.40 semitones against the target's 5.24 - averaging compresses the actual register motion by roughly 40%
per-track corr(global mean, top voice) spans 0.408 to 0.772, i.e. how badly the mean stands in for the melody is itself arrangement-dependent
hypothesis_SUPPORTED.verdict: SUPPORTED. Register is not one scalar. Collapsing an independently-moving top voice and bass voice into one weighted mean destroys both.

consequence_for_reading_J3C.what_J3C_established: the existing frontend does not recover the GLOBAL VELOCITY-WEIGHTED MEAN MIDI NUMBER. Best of 12 deterministic estimators: R^2 0.168. Best of 2 bounded nonlinear probes: R^2 0.199. Against a pre-registered SUFFICIENT bar of R^2 >= 0.70 and MAE <= 3.0 semitones.
consequence_for_reading_J3C.what_J3C_did_NOT_establish: that the frontend cannot expose register. The quantity it failed to recover is one that averages two nearly-independent musical voices together, so a spectral estimator has no single thing to find.
consequence_for_reading_J3C.the_forbidden_inference: 'register is absent from this frontend' is NOT supported by this evidence, because the target lacked construct validity for the broader notion of register.
consequence_for_reading_J3C.the_supported_inference: the GLOBAL MEAN formulation of register should not be carried forward. Voice- or source-conditioned register is the formulation that the label statistics say actually exists.

still_says_nothing_about: any other tonal or melodic construct
